name: Clover Voice
description: Your bots' voices: it speaks their replies aloud in each bot's voice, one at a time on this computer, through the voice provider the bot uses (Fish Audio, or another you add), and hears what you say with push-to-talk. Turned off, bots are text-only.

clover.voice.providers.doc: A voice provider: `speak` answers `{ text, voice, model?, format }` with the audio as it is made (pcm16-24k bytes, through points.stream); the optional `ready` answers `{ ready, why? }`, whether the user set it up (its key or sign-in). A bot's voice names the entry's id.

clover.voice.modes.doc: Another way to speak the bots' replies, used while its plugin is the active voice (the platform's `voiceModes`, one at a time, the user's pick in Settings): `reply` is handed `{ bot, session, text, asked }` and speaks it its own way (its own background part, taking device/speech).

clover.voice.defaults.doc: A bot plugin's default voice for its own bot (the bot of its own tree; any other's is ignored): `provider` (an entry of clover.voice.providers), `voice`, `model?`. The user's own choice in the bot's Voice section always wins, and a default speaks only when its provider is set up.

speakReplies.title: Speak replies
speakReplies.description: Your bots say their replies aloud with their voices. Off, they stay text-only.

provider.title: Voice provider
provider.description: The provider of this bot's voice (an entry of Clover Voice's providers, such as fish-audio). Empty: the bot is text-only.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: This bot's voice, as its provider names it.

model.title: Voice model
model.description: The provider's voice model for this bot; empty is the provider's default.
